title: Clinical Informatics Analyst
description: We are looking for a Clinical Informatics Analyst to support our Allscripts implementation and optimization efforts at UCLA Medical Center. This role requires strong technical skills, excellent communication abilities, and a deep understanding of healthcare workflows. You will be responsible for ensuring successful system adoption across our organization.
responsibilities: Collaborate with clinical stakeholders to gather requirements and design optimal workflows
Configure and customize Allscripts applications to meet organizational needs
Develop and maintain project documentation, including design specifications and test plans
Participate in system testing, including unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing
Provide go-live support and post-implementation optimization
Analyze clinical and operational workflows to identify improvement opportunities
Create detailed system specifications and configuration documents
Develop reports and dashboards for clinical and operational metrics
Troubleshoot system issues and implement solutions

required_qualifications.experience: 2+ years of healthcare IT implementation experience

certifications: Certified Professional in Healthcare Information and Management Systems (CPHIMS)
